summary:
Qualify the actual active producer and complete consumer ordering early. A stored namespace-handle-file schema existed, but the delegated bridge actually used an owned-pause producer. A consumer requiring legacy stored-file facts could not truthfully accept that active output. Home added a distinct capture schema rather than fabricating legacy flags; Root amended its reserved consumer with exact helper/pause birth, namespace, boot, source, handle and original-clock joins. Causal source controls passed the actual new producer output through the actual consumer and showed the earlier consumer rejecting that same output. These establish source compatibility, not a deployed namespace or reader-safety result. Public source checkpoint: https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6411063582 ; scoped source acceptance: https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6411272729 .

A gate cannot await evidence created only after that same gate releases. Here the worker waited for the reader gate before the engine bootstrap/unshare that produces the namespace evidence. The coherent proposed order separates private bootstrap from old-store exposure: hold actual original worker/guard/cgroup/OFD custody; allow private bootstrap only; capture; obtain authenticated Root live-positive arm; consume that exact arm and genuine deployed qualification before old-store exposure/copy. Home owns complete gate, no-FD-export, partial-writer, backing and retirement integration. At this source checkpoint the complete ordered prefix and runtime admission remained unimplemented. The source proposal grants no gate switch.

Runtime-bound observations must allow an owned process to finish. A proposed outer executor tried to capture manager identity only after controller entry, while demanding both controller and supervisor remain live. The fixture could already have retired. Root held source approval for that ordering race. The chosen repair waits the actual owned scope client, then joins immutable controller-wait receipts and independent cold/cgroup absence as a typed already-retired result. It issues no live-manager RPC on that success path and must preserve failures without retry or relabeling. The repaired executor subsequently passed32pure controls and independent source review; actual Home admission and native qualification remained unselected. Source-only handoff: https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6411663419 . A cooperative process timer does not establish hard forest containment; the native scope bound and actual outside proof remain separate.

Do not transfer development-container resource limits to another execution facility. Root found a proposed requirement that Home inherit its source worker's CPU/memory ceiling. Actual parent max/finite values, live capacity, declared helper share and process limits must be distinguished from the native scope's actual hard limits. Missing facility facts remain supplier inputs; arbitrary borrowed ceilings cannot manufacture them or justify building a new facility. Exact source, runtime/ELF closure, operator, output-writer custody and remaining capacity still require their actual admission.

Delivered agent messages do not prove an owner is running. Root sent repair findings to a completed worker using a queue-only message call; the worker did not restart, causing avoidable idle time and stale estimates. Root explicitly restarted the same owner, checked running status, withdrew the estimate and recorded ownership at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6411375615 . Use the supported follow-up dispatch when resuming a completed owner and verify state at that boundary; do not add reporting workers or another ledger.

Reuse unchanged qualified bytes and fetch only missing determining evidence. Root reused the accepted archive/source joins while Home supplied the missing exact run/job JSON through its existing endpoint-specific OAuth route. No new token/App, workflow rerun or full-suite confirmation was needed. Native policy403 remains unavailable, never empty policy. Reduced approval churn has earlier bounded execution evidence, but token savings remain unmeasured. All original failures, uncertain effects and separate clocks remain retained; these source/process findings do not qualify full export, bake, registration or a consumer.
title: Verify active producer ordering, owner execution and real facility limits
